title: Anastrozole Administration in Elderly Hypogonadal Men
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the effects of sustained aromatase inhibitor therapy to reduce estrogen levels in elderly men with mild hypogonadism (a decreased level of sex hormones).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men ages 60 and older
* Serum testosterone between 150-300 ng/dL
* Symptoms suggestive of androgen deficiency
